legendTitle: The same attention roles, with source and target labels
provenance: A new trained toy uses three-number representations and one head in each attention block. The coordinates have no assigned English meanings. Source and target use separate learned embedding tables and added position vectors. The numerical toy omits feed-forward sublayers and LayerNorm; Part 3 covers those parts of the full architecture.

hook: Translate the river bank into French: la rive, not la banque. Only the English sentence can settle it. How does a decoder read another sequence while it writes?
